notes: Single rule table shared by pre_tool_guard.py (deny), post_edit_verify.py (warn), and audit.py (both). Scope uses glob syntax matched against the root-relative path.

rules.message: Possible AWS access key in file content.
rules.fix: Remove the key, rotate it, and load it from a secret manager or .env (never committed).

rules.message: Private key material in file content.
rules.fix: Remove immediately, rotate the key, use a secret manager.
Read from environment or secret manager; keep only a placeholder in .env.example.

rules.message: Real .env file caught by the write guard.
rules.fix: Unstage it; only .env.example belongs in version control.
Replace with JSON.parse, a lookup table, or a proper parser.
Render structured content or sanitize with a reviewed sanitizer at the sink.

rules.message: innerHTML assignment is an XSS sink.
rules.fix: Use textContent / DOM construction or a sanitizer.

rules.message: div-as-button breaks keyboard and screen-reader interaction.
Possible fake heading (styled div/span instead of h1-h6).
rules.fix: Use a real heading element with sequential level.

rules.message: Global * reset cannot be overridden by components or lower layers.
!important outside the utilities layer hides the real conflict.
rules.fix: Fix layer order or scope the rule; keep !important in utilities only.

rules.message: transition: all animates unintended properties and hurts performance.
rules.fix: List the animated properties explicitly (prefer transform/opacity).

rules.message: Literal color in CSS bypasses the token system.
rules.fix: Use a semantic token from frontend-design-language/tokens/.

rules.message: Stub marker will ship if the stop-gate is bypassed.
rules.fix: Implement it now or file a tracked issue and reference its id.
Remove or route through the logging middleware.

rules.message: debugger statement halts execution for every user.
SELECT * couples queries to schema order and over-fetches.
